title: the inbox renders a plan of outcomes, and no line carries a [?] marker
intention: The operator inbox's deep view renders a ticket's outcomes (n, claim or 'awaiting judgement: <text>', after) and its old decisions alike, and no line carries a by marker, '[?]' included.
why: Measured 2026-11-14: Q#100 is answered and the plan becomes outcomes (outline 9.3.5.1.2.1); this component reads ticket plans, so by RULE 1 its dual-read is its own ticket, a sibling of aa3e9a70db47 (the migration).
traces_to: Law 5 (the plan carries what a builder needs now), RULE 1 (each reader changes inside its own component); outline 9.3.5.1.2.1.
how: Dual-read during the change: compose base's published plan view (5c1e0a7d93b2); after: 5c1e0a7d93b2.

clauses.claim: an outcomes ticket renders OUTCOMES with each outcome's n and claim, a no-claim outcome as 'awaiting judgement: <text>', and each non-empty after
a decisions ticket renders every line's n and text as before, and no rendered line contains '[?]' or a by suffix

decisions.text: D1: _decisions_section becomes the plan section: an outcomes plan renders 'OUTCOMES:' with '<n>. <claim> (after <list>)', an outcome with no claim as '<n>. awaiting judgement: <text>'; a decisions plan renders as today minus the ' [<by>]' suffix, so '[?]' never renders. It composes cairn.tools.base.plan (ticket 5c1e0a7d93b2): clauses(doc) gives [{n, claim}] from outcomes that carry a claim, else falsifier.clauses; steps(doc) gives [{n, text, writes_to, reads, after}] from outcomes (text = claim, else the migrated text), else decisions; it keeps no second reading of either shape.
D2: the red-first proof feeds the reader one ticket in each shape carrying the same content, one tooth per clause.
D3: the v2 tooth of test_operator_inbox.py asserts the retired ']' marker is absent, and the v1 render baseline regains the wrap 60e1dd170's rename hand-edit shifted (it stood red on main).

the verdict's first criterion named cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/fixtures/v1_render_baseline.txt, a fixture the proofs read, as a proof; the chart is redrafted with only the test_*.py proofs (test_operator_inbox.py, test_the_inbox_renders_a_plan_of_outcomes.py) as instruments, and the build on main is unchanged
